name: Four Seasons Hotel Jakarta
positioning: All-suite luxury hotel at the centre of the Capital Place development in south Jakarta
best_for: Business travelers working in south Jakarta
Travelers who want a city oasis with a pool and spa

facts.text: Opened in 2016 with 125 rooms, all of them suites.
The architect was César Pelli, the interiors are by Alexandra Champalimaud, and the gardens and landscaping are by Bill Bensley.
It is the centrepiece of the Capital Place mixed-use development on Jalan Gatot Subroto, with easy access to the Sudirman Central Business District and Mega-Kuningan.
The hotel is 40 minutes by car from Soekarno-Hatta International Airport.
Palm Court is the main restaurant, serving elevated twists on local dishes, with daily afternoon tea and Sunday brunch. Signature dishes include Javanese lobster laksa and tom yum risotto.
Alto is an authentic Italian restaurant on the 20th floor.
Nautilus Bar serves craft cocktails with small plates inspired by local flavours, and La Patisserie sells cakes, pastries and batik chocolate pralines.
The spa is inspired by the iris flower and has 8 treatment rooms, including 2 couple's suites. The fitness centre is open 24/7.

highlights.text: The outdoor pool and terrace sit among lush tropical landscaping, with a poolside bar, on the fourth floor.
Every suite has wall-to-wall windows, and the hotel displays a collection of local art, its Art Map, tracing Indonesian history over four centuries.
Palm Court breakfast is served beneath a custom Lasvit chandelier.
The hotel arranges Indonesian experiences, including culinary journeys with Chef Asep Hamdani, volcano visits, and Taman Safari trips.

considerations.text: Jakarta's notorious traffic congestion can lengthen travel times to key attractions and neighborhoods.
The city-centre location means limited access to natural landscapes or beach settings.
The airport is 40 minutes away by car, per the hotel's own fact sheet, before any traffic delays.
The outdoor pool measures 5.4 by 27.2 metres (about 17.7 by 89.2 feet), so it is a compact terrace pool rather than a large resort pool.
